description: The language server a release bundles: `comline.languageServer.rev` in package.json, tracked against the head of language-server's default branch (no currentValue: the git-refs datasource then looks up HEAD)
The bundled language server's bump is its own pull request, reviewed by hand: it changes what every release ships
prBodyNotes: Check that the language server's `comline-core` is the one the CLI uses (`comline-lsp --version` and `comline --version` print it) before merging.
